items.title: Blended diet for enteral nutrition: an evolutionary concept analysis
items.summary: Aim: Many terms are used to describe blended diet for enteral nutrition and there is no universal agreement on what constitutes one. This work aims to define the concepts of blended diet and provide the reader with two clear definitions for homemade blended diet and commercial blended diet.
